HALF_A_exact_band_refc_fans._read: EXACT 2 s along-track band. Route = the as-trained selector (argmax anchor logits) restricted to survivors. This is the band V5 S7.2 pre-registered, on the fans whose trajectories are actually in the repo.

absurdity_census._read: implied mean speed = s / 2 s. The comparison speed is the MAX OBSERVED v0 over this deployment (an INPUT, not held-out error).

HALF_B_surrogate_band_v4_fan._read: v4's per-candidate trajectories are NOT staged, so the band is applied to `C2_wm_ref_proximity` = mean_j ||cand_j - wm_ref_j||, the distance to the world model's roll-out under the OBSERVED action. Ground-truth-free. A candidate that deviates from that reference by a constant relative acceleration a has mean offset THETA_PER_A * a, so the SAME physical a_max grid maps onto a threshold in metres.
HALF_B_surrogate_band_v4_fan._degeneracy_warning: as theta -> 0 the survivor set collapses to argmin C2, so ANY route degenerates to arm C2. The `mean_survivors` and `ctrl_random_on_survivors` columns are what separate a real route effect from that collapse and must be read with every row.

HALF_C_rank_profile_bound._read: E[ade_0_2s | the rule's r-th ranked candidate]. If NO r is competitive, no tail-removal clip can rescue that rule.
